verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents official SDKs for browser, iOS, Android, Node.js and other platforms, with per-platform doc pages, but they only cover event ingestion into Hightouch Events. The core platform (syncs, models, sources, destinations) is exposed only as a REST API with a published OpenAPI spec, which is a building block rather than an official client SDK. missing for 10: official SDKs for the management/REST API (syncs, models, audiences), evidence of SDK depth beyond event tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
